title: Rotlewi–Rubinstein: Rubinstein’s Immortal

primaryAnnotation.title: The Best Chess Games Of All Time, section9
primaryAnnotation.author: Chess.com staff
primaryAnnotation.scope: All three explicitly double-exclaimed mainline moves in this game section.

title: Kasparov–Topalov: Kasparov’s Immortal

primaryAnnotation.author: Chess.com staff; explicit marks in NM Sam Copeland’s selected commentary
primaryAnnotation.scope: Both double-exclaimed mainline moves named in the game section.
